about.introText: FOUTSET AFRICA is a Cameroonian company of engineers and technicians specialised in deploying and maintaining telecom and network infrastructure, serving operators, service providers and institutions across Cameroon and Central Africa.
about.missionText: To provide and deliver leading-edge technology support services to our clients and partners, nationally and internationally.
about.visionText: To respond effectively to the evolving needs of our partners, clients and stakeholders across the continent.

cta.title: Tell us where the site is.
cta.subtitle: A link to establish, a network to extend, a team to train, hardware to bring in. Describe the need and we will come back with a survey and a quote.

contact.metaDescription: Contact FOUTSET AFRICA in Douala, Cameroon, for your telecom and network infrastructure projects. Request a quote or talk to our engineering team.

reseaux-telecom.metaDescription: VSAT deployment (C, Ku, Ka bands), satellite TV broadcasting, GSM/3G/4G LTE base stations, turnkey tower and mast installation and network security in Cameroon and Central Africa.
reseaux-telecom.heroSubtitle: Designing, deploying and securing the networks that carry the continent.
reseaux-telecom.introParagraph1: Foutset Africa designs, installs and maintains complete telecommunications infrastructure: VSAT satellite links in C, Ku and Ka bands, GSM/3G/4G LTE base stations, microwave links and turnkey tower and mast installations. Our team works across the whole chain, from the technical survey to commissioning.
reseaux-telecom.introParagraph2: Our satellite capability also covers Direct-to-Home (DTH) television broadcasting of SDTV, HDTV and UHDTV content, as well as GSM backhaul over satellite, which extends mobile traffic into the most remote areas where fibre and terrestrial microwave do not reach.
reseaux-telecom.domainsSubtitle: Complete technical solutions, from satellite links and mobile networks through to site security.
reseaux-telecom.feature1Description: Installation of VSAT terminals in C, Ku and Ka bands using SCPC or TDM/TDMA technology, with throughput up to 200 Mbps and contention ratios adjustable up to 1:20 following a link budget study, plus DTH television broadcasting (SDTV, HDTV, UHDTV) standalone or hybrid with terrestrial internet, and GSM backhaul over satellite.
reseaux-telecom.feature2Description: Deployment of GSM/3G/4G LTE base stations and microwave systems, with RF optimisation, drive testing and performance indicator (KPI) monitoring.
reseaux-telecom.compactDescription: VoIP, LAN/WLAN and server infrastructure deployment, plus turnkey tower and mast installation for enterprise and operator networks.
reseaux-telecom.darkDescription: Installation of alarm systems, lightning protection and CCTV surveillance systems to secure your technical sites.
reseaux-telecom.closingTitle: Connectivity as a lever for growth.
reseaux-telecom.closingParagraph: In a hyperconnected world, network infrastructure is no longer a cost centre but the backbone of your development. We design robust architectures able to carry your future ambitions.
reseaux-telecom.ctaLabel: Let's talk about your network project

formation.metaDescription: Hands-on technical training in the installation, commissioning and maintenance of VSAT, mobile network and telecom infrastructure, for a lasting local service in Cameroon and Central Africa.
formation.heroSubtitle: Strengthening local technical skills, for the long run.
formation.introParagraph1: Foutset Africa trains technical teams in the installation, commissioning and maintenance of the systems it deploys: networks, telecom, mobile base stations and VSAT infrastructure. Our courses combine theory with hands-on field practice.
formation.introParagraph2: Our aim is to provide a lasting service to local teams, so that our clients and partners keep operational autonomy over the long term.
formation.domainsSubtitle: Technical training tracks, aligned with our fields of work.
formation.feature1Description: Training in the installation, commissioning and maintenance of VSAT satellite systems.
formation.feature2Description: Training in the installation, commissioning and maintenance of GSM/3G/4G LTE base stations and microwave links.
formation.compactDescription: Training in the commissioning and maintenance of networks and telecom infrastructure.
formation.darkDescription: Field support and certification of local teams for lasting autonomy.
formation.closingTitle: Skills that stay, long after the project.
formation.closingParagraph: Training is an investment in the durability of infrastructure. Every job is also an opportunity to build our clients' and partners' technical capacity for good.
formation.ctaLabel: Let's talk about your training project

prestation.metaDescription: Qualified engineers and technicians, technical consulting and supply of telecom and ICT infrastructure equipment, in Cameroon and Central Africa.
prestation.heroSubtitle: A technical and human service, dedicated to your projects.
prestation.introParagraph1: Foutset Africa offers general consulting on your telecom and ICT infrastructure projects, along with qualified technicians and engineers to strengthen your teams in the field.
prestation.introParagraph2: From feasibility study to final acceptance, we run every job with a rigorous methodology, holding to schedule and to safety standards. We also supply the telecom and IT infrastructure equipment your projects need.
prestation.domainsSubtitle: Technical and human support, at every stage of your projects.
prestation.feature1Description: General engineering consulting on your telecom and ICT infrastructure products and projects.
prestation.feature2Description: Specialist technicians and engineers made available to strengthen your teams.
prestation.compactDescription: Sourcing and supply of telecom and IT infrastructure equipment, including VSAT systems, for your projects.
prestation.darkDescription: Project management methods that hold to schedule and to international safety standards.
prestation.closingTitle: Your project, our rigour in execution.
prestation.closingParagraph: Every engagement is run to the same standard: proven methodologies, a qualified team, and a commitment on timing.
prestation.ctaLabel: Let's talk about your consulting need

equipment-supply.metaDescription: Supply of telecom, VSAT, network and security equipment, sourced from qualified suppliers and delivered on site in Cameroon and Central Africa, with quality control at every step.
equipment-supply.heroSubtitle: The right equipment, in the right place, at the right time.
equipment-supply.introParagraph1: Foutset Africa supplies the telecom and ICT infrastructure equipment your projects need: network hardware, VSAT systems, towers and masts, solar and power backup, and security systems.
equipment-supply.introParagraph2: We work through a network of qualified suppliers to guarantee the availability, compliance and traceability of the equipment delivered to your sites.
equipment-supply.domainsSubtitle: From equipment selection through to on-site delivery.
equipment-supply.feature1Description: Supply of IT/telecom infrastructure, VSAT and solar systems, selected against your specifications.
equipment-supply.feature2Description: Transport and delivery of technical equipment to your sites, including the most remote areas.
equipment-supply.compactDescription: Compliance checks on equipment before on-site delivery.
equipment-supply.darkDescription: A network of qualified suppliers to guarantee availability and traceability.
equipment-supply.closingTitle: The right equipment, on site, on time.
equipment-supply.closingParagraph: A well-executed project also depends on a dependable supply chain. We secure the availability of your equipment, from supplier through to site.
equipment-supply.ctaLabel: Let's talk about your equipment need

energie.metaDescription: Solar and backup power for telecom sites and remote facilities: supply, installation and maintenance, in Cameroon and Central Africa.
energie.heroSubtitle: Reliable power for sites far from the grid.
energie.introParagraph1: A network is only as reliable as the power behind it. Foutset Africa supplies and installs solar and backup power systems for telecom sites, remote facilities and the equipment they carry.
energie.introParagraph2: We size the system to the load and the site, install it, and hand it over with its documentation, so your sites keep running when the grid does not.
energie.domainsSubtitle: Power that holds, from the study to the maintenance.
energie.feature1Description: Solar power systems sized for telecom sites and remote facilities.
energie.feature2Description: Batteries and backup supply to keep equipment running through grid outages.
energie.compactDescription: Preventive and corrective maintenance of the power systems we install.
energie.darkDescription: Every installation is sized against the real load and the conditions of the site.
energie.closingTitle: Keep the site on, whatever the grid does.
energie.closingParagraph: Describe the site and its load. We come back with a proposal for the power system and a quote.
energie.ctaLabel: Let's talk about your energy need

diffusion-tv-vsat.metaDescription: Direct-to-Home TV broadcasting (SDTV, HDTV, UHDTV) and VSAT internet connectivity in C and Ku bands, dedicated or shared, up to 200 Mbps, in Cameroon and Central Africa.
diffusion-tv-vsat.heroSubtitle: A TV bouquet and an internet link, wherever the site is.
diffusion-tv-vsat.introParagraph1: Foutset Africa designs and operates Direct-to-Home (DTH) television broadcasting solutions in SDTV, HDTV and UHDTV, along with dedicated or shared VSAT internet links, in C and Ku bands.
diffusion-tv-vsat.introParagraph2: A channel bouquet can be built and broadcast within the satellite footprint, standalone or hybrid with terrestrial internet; VSAT connectivity is sized in throughput and antenna size following a link budget study.
diffusion-tv-vsat.domainsSubtitle: From television broadcasting to internet connectivity, in C and Ku bands.
diffusion-tv-vsat.feature1Description: Direct-to-Home broadcasting of SDTV, HDTV and UHDTV content, with current compression standards, standalone or hybrid with terrestrial internet.
diffusion-tv-vsat.feature2Description: Dedicated or shared internet links using SCPC or TDM/TDMA, up to 200 Mbps, with contention ratios adjustable up to 1:20.
diffusion-tv-vsat.compactDescription: Antenna and bandwidth sizing following a satellite link budget analysis.
diffusion-tv-vsat.darkDescription: Solutions deployed in C or Ku band, depending on coverage and site climate conditions.
diffusion-tv-vsat.closingTitle: A reliable signal, to the most remote site.
diffusion-tv-vsat.closingParagraph: Broadcasting and connectivity run on the same satellite infrastructure: we size the solution best suited to your site and use.
diffusion-tv-vsat.ctaLabel: Let's talk about your TV / VSAT project

productsPage.title: Our products
productsPage.subtitle: Equipment and turnkey systems for satellite, broadcast and mobile network links, sized to your site and installed on location.

tv.title: Satellite TV broadcast
tv.lead: Direct-to-Home television, from the headend to the dish.
tv.detail: FOUTSET AFRICA supplies and installs the equipment for Direct-to-Home (DTH) satellite television: headends, encoders, uplink and receiving systems, in SDTV, HDTV and UHDTV, for operators and for dedicated or shared platforms.

vsat.title: VSAT connectivity
vsat.lead: Satellite internet and data links, wherever the terrestrial network stops.
vsat.detail: VSAT terminals, modems and antennas in C, Ku and Ka bands, sized to the site’s throughput and contention needs, for internet access, corporate networks and remote monitoring.
points: C, Ku and Ka band terminals

gsm.title: GSM backhauling
gsm.lead: The link that carries a base station’s traffic back to the core network.
gsm.detail: Microwave and satellite backhaul links for GSM/3G/4G LTE base stations, sized for the site’s traffic and its distance from the nearest point of presence.
